/method/: How a claim is graded (the five words) and the rules for reading a register. Nothing else states them.
/sources/: The register of sources: what each was used for, how it was read, how well each claim resting on it is known. Now also carries an Atlas note and a Deep dives section.
/searched/: Every query this archive ran, in sets, with its question, answer, note and verdict. The Atlas has the source and volume marks only.
/open-questions/: The open questions, each with the record set that would answer it.
/errands/: The places where someone at a counter could settle a question, with what to ask.
/worklist/: The work list: every task by number, owner and date. The only place the reason for a decision is kept.
/corrections/: Every claim published and taken back, with the cause named.
/documents/: The register plates and photographs, each with its archival reference.
/gallery/: Every image on the site in one contact sheet, with a link to where it is read.
/whats-new/: What was read, found and corrected lately, newest first (stays in Start as well).
/research-log/: An index of the working-notes files, one per register volume. Now under What's new.
/antenati/: Why a nil was safe; what the portal holds for Arienzo, Moiano, Paolisi and the Valle Caudina; the dossier findings. A deep dive now, with an Atlas note.
/processetti/: The marriage files: which volumes exist, which are read, and what the first one opened gave. A deep dive now.
/holdings/: Town by town, what exists, how each collection misleads, and what no search can reach. A deep dive now, with an Atlas note.
/the-library/: The bibliography as this archive used it, the working data, and the unread shelf. A deep dive now, with an Atlas note.
